items.title: Janis Siegel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 22, 2015
items.q: Dory, one of the girls on there, is a lawyer.

ctx.x: But that didn’t really happen. And what actually — Dory, one of the girls on there, is a lawyer. She’s already retired. And Rona went into computers or something or other.
What would cause — you know someone said this to me the other day. I ran into a fellow musician and he said to me, “gee it’s about time you retired, isn’t it?” It sort of took me aback.
